On 31 August 2023 the Security Council adopted France’s draft S/2023/641 as resolution 2695 (2023), 13–0–2, with China and Russia abstaining. The resolution extended the existing UNIFIL mandate through 31 August 2024. It reaffirmed independent performance of mandated tasks without prior permission and continued coordination with Lebanon’s Government under the status-of-forces agreement.

Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work. It judged that the French text kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely, while addressing some of Lebanon's concerns.
